utterances.text: That's page 107, under number 15.

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: "The private initiative party, 17.301."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. And now can you please look at page 109. On that page, number 45, payments for service industries, and under 57, underneath that, it says "57, participation in the financing of the institute for the protection of male children and youth, 400.000 dinars," or I don't know what currency was then valid.

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Dinars were used at that time.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is that the institute for retarded children in Cirkin Polje?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is the institute for mentally retarded children and adolescents, and I believe that this was its name. It was one of the major problems we faced at the time.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: In that institute, were there beneficiaries of all ethnic groups in more or less equal numbers?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: I know that there were beneficiaries of all ethnic groups, but I don't know what their ratio was, how many of each of the ethnic groups were there.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Was this institute also financed from the budget of the republic during, so to say, normal times, but then when problems arose, it had to be financed from the budget of the municipality?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can't say that for a fact. All I know is that it became the concern of the municipality of Prijedor. Actually, there were some attempts to raise money from other republics or other parts for their respective beneficiaries. I remember that clearly because the director of that institute would pay me a visit very often to talk to me because he did not receive the money on a regular basis. So this institute was not a municipal institution, an institute under municipal care. It had beneficiaries from the territory of the entire Yugoslavia, of the entire former Yugoslavia. There were people from all over the place in that institution.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So this institute or this institution also received extraordinary payments from the municipal budget because of the circumstances that prevailed in the municipality at the time?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We will no longer need this document. You can take it away. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Collection centre Orlovaca is mentioned on page 2, line 19 of today's transcript. Is that a collection centre for the equipment? Was there a collection centre for equipment of some sort?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: In Orlovci at the checkpoint established by the police, there was a collection centre where people who had plundered other people's property were -- that property was taken away from them, and it was collected in Orlovci at the police checkpoint.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So it is not a collection centre for people?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no, we're talking about agricultural machinery that were taken away from those who had plundered their owners.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I would like now the usher to show the witness the Exhibit Number S262, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Travar --

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Just a moment, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The document that you have been shown starts in a different place, not in the place that the Prosecutor showed you. So can you please read on the top of that page.

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: It says here: "The Serbian remocratic party," but I believe that it is the Serbian democratic party, "the municipal board Prijedor, regarding the opinion on the appointment of officials requested at a session held on 8th of September, 1992, the election and appointments commission of the Prijedor SO consider the conclusion of the Prijedor municipality Executive Board prompting the consideration of the mandate of Executive Board members and other officials appointed to their posts for six months."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you please read who the signatory of this document is. Who signed it?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: It says it is the chairman of that commission, Dragan Savanovic, but there's no signature.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Was Mr. Dragan Savanovic the president of the group of SDS deputies?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: In the mixed assembly, I believe that he was. I believe that I heard that on the media. Or I listened to the broadcast of one of the sessions of that mixed assembly on the radio, and I believe that he was the president of the group of SDS representatives.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You've been shown -- just a moment. The page at the top of which it says "The Serbian democratic party of Bosnia and Herzegovina, OOS Prijedor." I believe we're talking about page 6.

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: You mean I have been shown that document by the Prosecutor? I believe that this was the page. It says "The Serbian Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Serbian Assembly of Prijedor Municipality." Yes, Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts. there was this one as well.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: On the following page, the one following the one that you have just seen, it says on the top "The Serbian democratic party of Bosnia and Herzegovina, OSDS Prijedor"?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: "The Serbian democratic party of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Executive Board, Prijedor." On page P00367, that's what it says. I'm reading the markings.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you now find page P0038605.

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And again, does it say the same?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, "SDS Prijedor."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: However, underneath, there is a line saying "minutes of the first session of the Serbian Assembly of Prijedor Municipality." Are these the minutes of this session or is that something that was drafted in the Prijedor SDS?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: It says here "the Serbian Democratic Party." I don't know where this document was drafted.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Was Srdjo Srdic a member of the Serbian Assembly of Prijedor Municipality?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: He was one of the assemblymen, one of the deputies. I don't know whether he was a member because a deputy could not be an assemblyman at the same time. I believe that to be the case, but I'm not familiar with these things.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You were talking about Document 0038607. Can you please open that page now. Again, the title "The Serbian Democratic Party of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the municipal board of the SDS in Prijedor." And it says: "Minutes of the fifth session of the Serbian Assembly of Prijedor Municipality," an abbreviated version. On the following page, page 2 of this document, at the top, we can see that it says "Srdjo Srdic insists that before the appointment of the members of the Executive Board, blank resignations should be signed and this proposal was rejected." Due to this role of Mr. Srdjo Srdic, is it more plausible that this was an SDS meeting rather than a meeting of the assembly, if you know?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know. I'm now confused. I have been confused about everything that I've seen.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Let me ask you one more thing: Was this document signed by the president of the assembly?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. There's no signature.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Were the minutes signed by the person who took the minutes?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you tell who was it who took the minutes, just by looking at the document?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Travar, thank you. I have no further questions to ask you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VASSYLENKO
utterances.text: Mr. Koumjian.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: If I could ask just a few brief questions before the break. Further questions by Mr. Koumjian:

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Sir, is the reason that you're confused about whether this was an assembly or SDS meeting because the Serb assembly was basically run by the SDS? It was the SDS that created the Serb assembly in Prijedor?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's why I said I was not clear why it says in the heading the Serbian democratic party. I know it was the Serbian Assembly who appointed all of us as members of the Executive Board.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Going to the issue of the collection centre at Orlovci, isn't it correct that the Kozaraputevi company was an operating company? It was operating throughout 1992? It was an ongoing enterprise? Correct?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it was operating. It existed.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Sir, then why would the equipment from an operating company be taken to a collection centre for stolen goods? Why wouldn't it have been returned to that company if that was the purpose?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know. I didn't say that this equipment belonged to Kozaraputevi, the equipment that was collected in that collection centre. The equipment that was collected there was taken away from those people who had looted the abandoned property in Kozarac, and that was the -- those were the goods that were collected at that police checkpoint.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: If the witness could be shown S250 again, and also the document that Mr. -- I believe it was 406, the document that Mr. Lukic showed the witness at the beginning of his testimony, redirect. S250, 406.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Sir, you were asked about S406 by Mr. Lukic a few moments ago, which was the document that he pointed out did not have a signature of Mr. Brdjanin or of yourself. It does have a number in the upper left, 02-111-179/92. If you look at the S250, the minutes of the assembly confirming the decisions of the Crisis Staff for the enactments passed on the 11th of June, 1992, do you see that the very first conclusion under that date is conclusion number 02-111-179/92 "requesting obligatory distribution of the conclusion of the Autonomous Region of Krajina in Banja Luka on personnel policy with respect to executive posts, to all socially-owned companies, public companies, and government institutions for the purposes of implementation." So this decision referred to in the document certified by you is again referred to and confirmed by the Municipal Assembly. Correct?

utterances.speaker: RANKO TRAVAR [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is what it says here. But I abide by my previous testimony. I didn't see this document before, although it does say here that the authenticity of this document certified by myself and it does say that it was adopted under item 9 on the 11th of June, 1992, under this number, although this number is not clear. It has been corrected. But 02-111-179, yes, it does say so here.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: Thank you. No further questions, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone for His Honour, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VASSYLENKO
utterances.text: So we conclude the testimony of the witness before us. Mr. Travar, the Chamber would like to thank you for coming to the International Tribunal to give your evidence in this case. And we wish you a safe and good trip home.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. If I may take this opportunity to thank you for a very correct and professional attitude towards me, and I would like to ask the Defence team and the Prosecution team, I'm very glad if my testimony has helped you to shed some light on the events that took place in Prijedor Municipality in 1992. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VASSYLENKO
utterances.text: You're excused. Please, usher, would like to...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VASSYLENKO
utterances.text: Before the break, I would like to clarify some issues related to the documents tendered by the OTP. First of all, the document, this report concerning the situation relating to the prisoners, collection centres marked by the registry as S407, but I have an impression that we already admitted this document in the evidence as S152.
